description: A six-panel composite of statistical histograms (orange bars with black outline and a fitted trend line) for three medium-Mn low-density steel samples, AN750, AN800 and AN850. Panels (a)-(c) are GND (geometrically necessary) dislocation density distributions: abscissa "Dislocation density" (ticks 0-800, no unit printed on the axis), ordinate "Proportion of quantity" (0-0.25); each panel has an inset box printing the mean as (a) ρ^GND_mean = 0.61×10^14 m^-2, (b) ρ^GND_mean = 0.84×10^14 m^-2, (c) ρ^GND_mean = 0.72×10^14 m^-2. All three are strongly right-skewed, mode below 100 with a tail extending to ~300; the AN800 distribution (b) is the sharpest and tallest (bar peak at the 0.25 gridline) and (c) slightly exceeds 0.25, consistent with their larger means. Panels (d)-(f) are Taylor factor distributions over 2.0-5.0 with "Proportion of quantity" ordinates and inset means M_average = 3.45 (AN750), 3.58 (AN800) and 3.53 (AN850). (d) peaks near 3.6-3.7; (e) has the highest narrow spike just above 3.6; (f) is the broadest, spanning ~2.4-4.6 with several sub-peaks. The figure shows AN800 reaches both the highest mean GND density and the highest mean Taylor factor, the basis for its largest dislocation-strengthening contribution.
measured_quantities: dislocation strengthening contribution (MPa, from citing text only)

observations.observation: Panels (a)-(c) plot 'Dislocation density' on the abscissa (ticks 0-800) versus 'Proportion of quantity' on the ordinate (0-0.25); no unit is printed on the dislocation-density axis.
The inset box in panel (a) prints ρ^GND_mean = 0.61×10^14 m^-2 for sample AN750.
The inset box in panel (b) prints ρ^GND_mean = 0.84×10^14 m^-2 for sample AN800.
The inset box in panel (c) prints ρ^GND_mean = 0.72×10^14 m^-2 for sample AN850.

Panels (d)-(f) plot 'Taylor factor' (2.0-5.0) versus 'Proportion of quantity', with inset means M_average = 3.45, 3.58 and 3.53 respectively; the y-axis tops out at 0.08 for (d) and (e) but at 0.06 for (f).
All GND density histograms are strongly right-skewed with the mode below 100 and a long tail reaching roughly 300, and the AN800 histogram (b) has the highest and narrowest peak among the three.
The caption assigns panels (a)-(c) to the GND density of AN750, AN800 and AN850 and panels (d)-(f) to their Taylor factor statistics.
The citing text states the GND densities are 0.61×10^14 m^-2, 0.84×10^14 m^-2 and 0.72×10^14 m^-2 for AN750, AN800 and AN850, matching the inset values printed in (a)-(c).
The citing text states the Taylor factor numbers are 3.45, 3.58 and 3.53 for AN750, AN800 and AN850, matching the inset values printed in (d)-(f).
The citing text states the resulting dislocation strengthening contributions are 263 MPa, 459 MPa and 414 MPa for AN750, AN800 and AN850; these values are not printed anywhere in the figure.

subfigures.description: Histogram of GND dislocation density for AN750: x = Dislocation density (0-800), y = Proportion of quantity (0-0.25), right-skewed with mode near 40-60 and peak ~0.20; inset box reads ρ^GND_mean = 0.61×10^14 m^-2.

Histogram of GND dislocation density for AN800, same axes as (a); the sharpest and highest of the three GND distributions (bar peak at the 0.25 gridline) with tail to ~300; inset reads ρ^GND_mean = 0.84×10^14 m^-2.
Histogram of GND dislocation density for AN850, same axes; right-skewed with a narrow peak just above the 0.25 gridline near 50-70; inset reads ρ^GND_mean = 0.72×10^14 m^-2.

Histogram of Taylor factor for AN750: x = Taylor factor (2.0-5.0), y = Proportion of quantity (0-0.08); broad unimodal-to-multimodal distribution peaking near 3.6-3.7 at ~0.085; inset reads M_average = 3.45.
Histogram of Taylor factor for AN800, same axes as (d); distribution spread over ~2.3-4.8 with the tallest narrow spike (above the 0.08 gridline) at about 3.6-3.7; inset reads M_average = 3.58.

Histogram of Taylor factor for AN850, x = Taylor factor (2.0-5.0), y = Proportion of quantity (0-0.06); the broadest distribution of the three, spanning ~2.4-4.6 with several resolved sub-peaks around 3.2, 3.6, 4.1 and 4.3; inset reads M_average = 3.53.
